Name: Kin's Miowee Extended Portraits
Author: kakakakakka
Description:
[center][size=4]☆[/size][u][size=4]Kin's Miowee Extended Portraits for Stardew Valley's Bachelors & Bachelorettes + Villagers 1.6 Edition![/size][/u][size=4]☆[/size]
[u]Works with Content Patcher.[/u][/center]
[center][i][size=2]Initial Release - 11/02/2025 version 1.2.0[/size][/i][/center]

[center][u]Includes:[/u]
[i][size=2][b]Bachelors[/b]: Alex, Sam, Elliot, Harvey, Sebastian, Shane
[b]Bachelorettes[/b]: Emily, Haley, Abigail, Leah, Maru, Penny
[b]Villagers[/b]: Caroline, Clint, Demetrius, Dwarf, Evelyn, George, Gus, Jas, Jodi, Kent, Krobus, Leo, Lewis, Linus,Marnie, Pam, Pierre, Robin, Sandy, Vincent, Willy, Wizard
[b]Non-giftable NPCs[/b]: Birdie, Bouncer, Fizz, Gil, Governor, Grandpa, Gunther, Henchman, Marlon, Morris, Mr. Qi, Professor Snail[/size][/i]
[i][b]In both winter,beach and jobs outfits![/b][/i][/center]



[u]Features additional toggles:[/u]
You can configure them in config.json or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].
[list]
[*]EmilyWinterHat: [size=2]CatHat / PomPom[/size] (Default: [size=2]CatHat[/size])[/*]
[*]ShaneBeachGlasses: [size=2]True / False[/size] (Default: [size=2]True[/size])[/*]
[*]ClintHasBeard: [size=2]True / False[/size] (Default: [size=2]True[/size])[/*]
[*]PamYassified: [size=2]True / False[/size] (Default: [size=2]False[/size])[/*]
[*]WizardHasBeard: [size=2]True / False[/size] (Default: [size=2]True[/size])[/*]
[*]WizardHasHat: [size=2]True / False[/size] (Default: [size=2]True[/size])[/*]
[*]WillyHasBeard: [size=2]True / False[/size] (Default: [size=2]True[/size])[/*]
[*]SamIsBlue: True / False (Default: True)[/*]
[/list]
